instruction.text: Answer the questions to help Enya plan her experiment.

atoms.a: Enya wants to test if she can use foam to make sounds seem quieter. What should she use to accurately measure the volume of the sound?

feedback.end: Using a decibel meter will be much more reliable than Enya’s opinion. It will also give us exact values, which can be put into graphs.

atoms.a: Enya needs to decide how much foam to use each time. Which thicknesses will give her the best results?

feedback.end: Exactly! This option uses sensible thicknesses of foam and also includes a result without any foam at all. This is called a control, and tests if the foam is making a difference in the first place.

instruction.text: Choose the correct words to fill the gaps in Enya’s hypothesis.

atoms.a: What is Enya changing as she conducts her experiment?
What is staying the same throughout the experiment?
